response.original_title: ((FAQS Person))- Can I add a person to my already booked Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280 you can add a person to an already booked Carnival cruise, provided your stateroom has the space and the ship has not reached its maximum capacity. Your room must physically accommodate an extra person (e.g., a sofa bed, upper Pullman, or extra berth). You cannot squeeze an extra guest +1-866-829-1280 into a standard double-occupancy room. Additions are typically allowed up to seven days before departure, +1-866-829-1280 subject to availability and sailing rules. You must call Carnival Customer Service directly +1-866-829-1280 or contact your travel agent or Personal Vacation Planner (PVP) to make the change.
